description: Read the attributes of any federal map layers at a WGS84 location: point-in-polygon (radius_m=0), everything within a radius in metres (e.g. antennas within 300 m), or everything inside a bbox. Up to 15 layers per call; results grouped per layer, with per-layer errors isolated if a layer id is bad. Examples: layers='ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag,ch.bag.radonkarte', lat=46.948, lon=7.4474; layers='ch.bakom.standorte-mobilfunkanlagen', radius_m=300, return_geometry=true. Use search_map_layers to find layer ids; for a ready-made multi-layer summary use get_location_report.

bbox.description: Alternative to lat/lon: WGS84 bbox [minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat], max ~5 km per side

lang.description: Language for labels/attributes: de, fr, it, rm or en (default en)

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres around lat/lon (0 = exactly at the point; max 2000)

return_geometry.description: Include a WGS84 anchor point per feature (useful with radius/bbox)

name: query_layer_at_point
title: Query up to 15 geo.admin.ch layers at a point, radius or bbox
